decision: Detect routing, skill-design, canonical-authority, evidence-lifecycle, remediation, and self-certification failures before release; this suite does not approve authored skills.

scope.intended_use: Creating or revising portable Agent Skills from coherent requirements, workflow evidence, or accepted findings.
scope.case_source: Synthetic authoring, refusal, remediation, interaction, authority, and evaluation-lifecycle cases with neighboring skill collisions.
excluded_claims: Compatibility with untested hosts or models

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names and descriptions until a single selection or required ordered composition is recorded.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the target explicitly in a disposable task-local workspace with only declared synthetic inputs.

evidence.storage: Keep contracts, cases, fixtures, graders, and harness inputs under evals; write routine generated runs only to the ignored or external workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing, package, file-state, and forbidden-effect checks plus assertion-based review of authored workflow quality.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, harness, output, or side-effect evidence produce unknown rather than pass.
critical_gates: No install or publish without separate authority
No self-certification of audit closure or production safety
Runtime and evaluation-source boundaries remain separate
grading.calibration: Check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown before relying on a model grader.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: Previous accepted exact revision under the same cases, environment, budgets, and graders when available.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline rather than inferring improvement.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, and harness failures visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the claimed scope.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent verification must remain labeled and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Skill, description, resource, or handoff-template changes
Case, grader, harness, or evidence-lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, authority, or intended-cohort changes
